description: This file defines the LoggerPropertyConfigurator class, which parses a configuration file to set up logging levels and appenders for different loggers within the vtiger CRM project. It includes methods for parsing, storing, and retrieving configuration info, and maintains a singleton instance.

classes.name: LoggerPropertyConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring logging settings based on a configuration file; manages singleton instance, parsing configuration, and providing getter for configuration info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the singleton instance of LoggerPropertyConfigurator.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Parses a given ini configuration file to set up logger types and appenders.

methods.name: getConfigInfo
methods.description: Retrieves configuration details (level and appender) for a specified logger type.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of LoggerPropertyConfigurator.
